name: Synapse Solutions
description: Innovating the future, one solution at a time.
story: Synapse Solutions, a leading Singaporean AI and data analytics firm, sees motorsport as the ultimate testing ground for real-time decision-making technology. They believe the fast-paced, data-rich environment of racing provides invaluable insights for their AI development. Synapse seeks a partnership that showcases their technology's capabilities and aligns with their values of precision, innovation, and speed.
